result.title: OmniVLoc: Topo-metric Visual Localization for Omnidirectional Cameras
result.summary: Omnidirectional cameras provide surround-view information, significantly overcoming the field-of-view constraints for traditional visual localization systems. However, existing localization systems fail to fully exploit the characteristics of omnidirectional cameras, struggling to deliver accurate and robust localization performance amidst scene content variations and illumination-induced appearance changes. In this work, we propose OmniVLoc, a surround-view localization system based on a topo-metric framework. By integrating state-of-the-art global place recognition and monocular depth estimation methods, we introduce a multi-constrained visual localization paradigm. By solving a scale-aware pose graph and performing precise spherical bundle adjustment, we accurately recover the metric-level pose for each query frame.Furthermore, a hierarchical verification mechanism is designed to filter out erroneous outputs across different stages, effectively bolstering the overall system robustness. Extensive experiments on both public and our custom datasets validate the superior accuracy and reliability of OmniVLoc. To benefit the community, our source code and dataset will be made publicly available upon publication.

AI.brief_summary: 提出面向全景相机的 topo-metric 视觉定位系统 OmniVLoc，结合全局场景识别与单目深度估计，通过尺度感知位姿图优化、球面 bundle adjustment 与分层验证恢复查询帧的度量级位姿。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于几何视觉定位与机器人建图系统，以手工几何优化和位姿求解为核心，不涉及 VLM 推理状态、视觉证据筛选或训练监督，与本主线缺乏实质联系；其中的分层验证仅为位姿管线内的错误剔除，不足以构成方法借鉴线索。
